issue.title: test_handoff_end_to_end_settles_through_proc flakes under full just check, passes in isolation
issue.description:
## Flake report

- **Test:** `tests/tool/test_handoff.py::test_handoff_end_to_end_settles_through_proc`
- **Repro:** `just check` (4-worker full lane)

Proposed by sase-17d.12.2 note #3 during the agent-deck spread inspection. The node failed under a 4-worker full `just check` and passed in isolation on the same tree. The phase note does not record the exception text. Fail rate from that report: 1 full-lane failure, then a pass in isolation. The deck diff does not touch tool handoff. The land agent did not re-run the full lane.
